clips.send: Someone who spends every night replaying the past or planning a far-off future sends this to a friend doing the same, as a nudge that Gordon Ramsay built his wealth standing in the present, not in a daydream.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau points to Gordon Ramsay as proof of something manifesting advice skips: you need a dream, but you cannot live inside it.

Ramsay came from nothing and built real wealth as a chef and entrepreneur. Kevin's take on his words: have a dream, but don't live in a dream world.

Confront your past so it stops running you. Picture your future. But the only place anything gets built is right now, in the present.

Most people swing between replaying yesterday and daydreaming about tomorrow, and skip the one moment that counts.

Where does your mind actually live most days?

#kevintrudeau #gordonramsay #mindsetshift #manifestation #successmindset #lawofattraction

clips.send: Someone who just bought another $500 success course sends this to a friend chasing the next guru, proof that most of it traces back, uncredited, to one $15 book from 1948.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says almost every self-help guru selling courses today is quietly repackaging one book from 1948: The Magic of Believing.

He says he has pulled apart their training, line by line, and traced it back to the same foundational principles - without the credit.

It is the book he was handed as basic training decades ago, and the one he still tells people to read, underline, and read again.

His claim: a dozen people who became famous and genuinely wealthy point to this exact book as the reason.

If the gurus are selling you their version of it, why not just read the original?

#kevintrudeau #themagicofbelieving #successmindset #wealthmindset #selfhelp #manifestation
